key_insight: LLM4EHR aligns clinical event sequences with time-series data using a domain-adapted LLM plus a transformer encoder to learn better ICU foundation representations.
clinical_relevance: This could improve how EHR data are turned into reusable embeddings for downstream ICU prediction tasks and support adaptation to new patient cohorts.
method: Domain-adapted large language model encodes EHR event sequences
Transformer time-series encoder learns aligned clinical TS representations
Regularised contrastive objective temporally matches events and observations
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved downstream clinical task performance in an ablation study and shows transferable time-series embeddings with k-shot adaptation on ICU EHR data.
watch_item: The approach depends on accurate temporal alignment between events and time series, which may be difficult across sites, cohorts, or EHR systems.
paper_title: LLM4EHR: Aligning Clinical Time Series with Medical Event Sequences via Large Language Models
